newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Sri Lanka buys May diesel, kero at 10-cts premium.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka buys May diesel, kero at 10-cts premium.

text.p: Sri Lanka's state-owned Ceylon Petroleum Corp (CPC) bought by tender gas oil and illuminating kerosene at 10 cents per barrel over Singapore spot quotes for May 10-12 delivery, cost-and-freight Trincomalee, a CPC source said on Friday.
The 85,000 barrels of 1.0-percent sulphur gas oil and 60,000 barrels of kerosene were purchased from Swiss trader Glencore.
The tender, which closed on April 23, received about six offers.
The source said CPC might decide to issue another tender for mid-May delivery to Colombo later on Friday.

In its previous tender, Sri Lanka bought from French oil company Total 220,000 barrels of gas oil and 80,000 barrels of jet fuel, both at eight cents per barrel over Singapore spot quotes, c-and-f Colombo for May 5-6 delivery.
